overall_worst.defect: The troubleshooting page puts counter-facing notices on the same page as developer material (errorCode strings like "register_session_already_open", tallyResolveNeedsAdmin GraphQL blocks, VENDUREPOS_WEB_ALLOW_LAN_HTTP). A shop owner reading it on a phone hits "Those closures and cash records do not reach your Vendure store from this till" and gets no plain step for what staff should do next.
overall_worst.where: troubleshooting.desktop.01-03 / troubleshooting.phone, 'When till updates need attention'
overall_worst.fix: Split the page in two. 'At the counter' keeps each notice with one plain action (e.g. 'keep the printed Z report and tell whoever runs your store'). 'For whoever runs your Vendure server' holds the errorCodes, the GraphQL and the LAN http note.
